Record Class Truth

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
dev.swordai.server.Truth
Record Components:
episodeId - counts up every time an episode reset has been applied
hopId - counts up every time the bot was repositioned (including resets)
agentSprinting - whether the server has the agent sprinting: what its next hit is judged with
error - non-null when the arena could not be set up; the session shows it and stops
public record Truth(boolean active, boolean botReady, UUID botUuid, int episodeId, int hopId, double centerX, double floorY, double centerZ, int radius, float botHealth, float botCharge, boolean botSprinting, boolean botOnGround, boolean agentSprinting, long tick, String error) extends Record
Snapshot of the arena, published by the server thread once per tick and read by the client thread. Immutable, so it can be handed across threads through a single volatile reference.

    • equals

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. Reference components are compared with Objects::equals(Object,Object); primitive components are compared with the compare method from their corresponding wrapper classes.
      Specified by:

      Parameters:

      Returns:
